Split on run_id / config_hash (ablate:<mechanism>) to recompute a probe.

Nothing here establishes anything about combinations, nor about mechanisms with no runtime toggle (F6 boundary guard, F7 reconciliation, F9 process supervision), nor about the membrane and durable store, which have no ablation row at all. policies.spend is included and admits nothing, which places it outside the kernel as a redundant layer rather than a hidden TCB element.
